task.question: release the runtime's memory by terminating a worker, price the int8 graphs, and measure cancel latency from the abort call instead of from the run start

decode.strategy: greedy (argmax per step, no sampling, no beam)
decode.kv_cache: self-attention KV only; cross-attention K/V recomputed inside decoder_kv.onnx each step
decode.input_truncation: adapter returns unsupported above 128 real tokens (ids include the appended </s>=1)
decode.note: max_input 128 / max_output 64 are the r3-direction training contract; the adapter does not pad or truncate below the gate

exitPolicy.compare.py: exit 0 only when every check passes; missing run groups, wrong case sets, hash drift, parity failure, a non-eos finish and a failed abort all produce exit 1
exitPolicy.offline_reference.py: exit 0 when the reference run is complete; fp32 must also reproduce the stored fixture ids, int8 is only required to be complete (it is expected to differ from the fp32 fixture)
exitPolicy.run_probe.mjs: exit 1 on parity failure (fp32 only), missing abort, or a run that stopped at maxTokens
exitPolicy.run_worker_probe.mjs: exit 1 on parity failure, missing abort, or (unless --no-rebuild) failed rebuild parity

int8.reading: browser-int8 reproduces ORT-python-int8 exactly on all 21 case-runs, so the browser adds no drift of its own. The 2/7 token differences versus fp32 are the quantisation effect: one clause reworded, same facts. Token identity is not required by the documented int8 contract, and quality is out of scope for c9

corrections.claimInRound1: release() 之后 300 ms 内存未下降，说明只能重载页面
corrections.whatTheDataShows: 把运行时放进 DedicatedWorker 后 terminate() 把可归因内存从 973.3 MB 降到 4.46 MB，重建 worker 再跑 7 个用例与离线一致
corrections.remainingClaim: 页面内 release() 不回收 wasm 内存；回收要靠终止承载它的 worker

corrections.claimInRound1: 最大取消延迟为 35–72 ms（单步耗时）
corrections.whatTheDataShows: 按 abort() 调用时刻到 AbortError 的间隔测：page 内 52.9–97.2 ms，worker 内 93–266.5 ms。上界是取消到达时正在执行的那次 ORT 调用的剩余时间
corrections.remainingClaim: 取消粒度是一步；延迟 = 在飞调用剩余时间 + 让出宏任务 + 检查

corrections.claimInRound2: terminate() 在 +103 ms 就把内存还到 4.46 MB
corrections.whatTheDataShows: round 2 的时间戳是采样*开始*的时刻，而 performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory() 本身要 13–60 s（它强制全量 GC）。所以那句话只能说明「以某个更晚时刻为准已经是 4.46 MB」，不能说明回收在 103 ms 内完成。补测：1 s 采样的浏览器进程树工作集在 terminate 后+0.19 s 仍为 1085.7 MB、+1.21 s 降到 378.6 MB（另一轮 +59 ms 仍 2014.8 MB、+1.13 s 降到 964.2 MB），即回收在约 1 s 内可观测，分辨率 1 s
corrections.remainingClaim: terminate() 是让内存回到基线的手段（973.3 → 4.46 MB，int8 713.1 → 4.46 MB，重建 worker 后输出一致）；回收耗时约 1 s 量级，但没能测到亚秒精度

corrections.claimInRound2: int8 与 fp32 离线参照有 2/7 用例 token 不同
corrections.whatTheDataShows: 补跑同一份 int8 图的 ORT-python 参照（runs/offline-reference-int8.json），浏览器 int8 三轮 × 7 用例与它逐 token 全同（21/21）；那 2 处差异在离线 int8 上完全一样地出现，因此差异来自量化本身，不是浏览器
corrections.remainingClaim: int8 的浏览器/离线一致性成立；int8 与 fp32 的 2 处措辞差异是量化效应

corrections.claimInRound3: terminate 后 +1.21 s 内存降到 378.6 MB，据此说「回收在约 1 秒内完成」
corrections.status: 撤回「完成」这一半（本轮的修正）
corrections.whatTheDataShows: r3 用的是「比终止时低 400 MiB」这一个阈值，它只能证明已经掉了一大块。拆成三个数重测（两次 no-rebuild 轮）：首次明显下降在 +0.81 s / +0.86 s，此时仍有约 996 MiB；之后继续缓降，到 +15 s 左右稳定在 597–606 MiB，而 worker 创建前是 620–623 MiB。每轮还有 2 次采样失败（计为 invalidSamples）。旧轮次的稳定值曾到 379 MiB，说明整树 RSS 受其它进程影响，只能同轮内比
corrections.remainingClaim: terminate 能大幅释放已证明（页面可归因 973.3 → 4.46 MB，int8 713.1 → 4.46 MB）；「模型堆何时全部释放」仍未确定，需更细采样或进程内记账才能给完成时刻

summary.claimLimit: the drop happening is proven; the instant the model's heap is fully released is not, because the series is whole-tree RSS at 1 s resolution and the final level mixes in the page, tokenizer, other browser processes and allocator retention

rssRuns.note: --rss runs sample the OS process tree every second from the driver; that steals CPU from the browser, so load/inference timings from these runs are excluded
